main_text.p: legitimam defensionem re-quiratur, ut ab insultante in-fultatus primum ictum[?] excipere teneatur, num vero ipsum insultantem primum ferire possit? Et licet nonnulli censeant vim illatam esse repellen-dam, non autem censeri illa-tam, si nondum percusserit ag-greffor; mihi tamen contraria sententia pro vera amplecten-da videtur. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ictum" in "primum ictum[?] excipere" is blurred, with a mark above the i that may be a macron or tilde; the word may not be "ictum". "ꝛ" in the note "quil. 1. ꝛ" is unclear and may be a numeral. The first and second note numbers ("1. 5.") and "Ad 1. A." are small and partly superscript, so they are approximate. The catchword "se" may be "se" or "sese" and is marked [?]. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The ligature "ct" in "amplecten-da" and "illa-tam" is read from print. No text reference marks appear in the body, so the notes have no letter attributes. Page number 153 is printed at the top right.
